method: Opened each of the five delivered recrops at native resolution and inspected complete musical content and all four edges against the authoritative source content reviewed in this session. Independently compared every decoded RGB pixel with the stated source PNG rectangle and checked source/PDF mapping against sources/index.json. All five are exact matches; no resampling, retouching or artificial border is present. Rectangles are source-local [left,top,right,bottom], right/bottom exclusive. Margin measurements below are distances to pixels with grayscale value below160, not a substitute for visual edge inspection.
scope_limit: This follow-up approves only the five named recrop files. It does not re-review the other48 records, modify any manifest or approve the three previously source-limited records. Overall milestone readiness is not established by this report.
